hints.title: Lowest Set Bit Clearing Trick
hints.text: Counting every bit position sequentially takes thirty-two iterations. What bitwise trick clears the lowest set bit in a single step?

hints.title: Bitwise Decrement Subtraction Invariant
hints.text: Evaluating n bitwise-and n minus 1 clears the least significant set bit while leaving all other bits completely unchanged.

hints.title: Brian Kernighan Bit Counting Procedure
hints.text: Repeatedly apply n bitwise-and n minus 1 while incrementing a counter until n becomes zero. Return the accumulated count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all 32 bits individually is constant time but always executes 32 loops even if only one bit is set.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kernighan bit-clearing runs in O(K) iterations where K is the number of 1-bits, using O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should know the n & (n - 1) trick to clear the lowest set bit efficiently.
